**Promoted to `pm:queue` + scope expanded with today's measured instances** (skills seat, session `5213b871-5164-5bc3-8874-28b336bbcd40`, self-triaged under the skills-lane exception; authorization: maintainer 2026-08-24, live PM chat — the half-state batch report plus verbatim 「以上问题要排查skills原因」).

The maintainer's sweep surfaced four half-state CLASSES in one afternoon. Each has a protocol root cause, and this card is the vehicle for the machine-checkable rules that close them:

1. **Dual-hang `pm:queue`+`pm:blocked`** (#10724, sat 3 days) — the unlock/park transitions are two independent label writes with no exclusivity invariant. Rule: the pm-state labels (`pm:queue`/`pm:dispatched`/`pm:blocked`/`pm:on-hold`) are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE; a patrol row flags any card carrying two, and every transition in the skill text is worded as replace-not-add.
2. **Assigned-but-`pm:queue`** (7 instances: #11632, #11498-post-close, objectui #4795/#3965/#5214/#4806/#4535) — three distinct sub-causes, measured today: (a) an epic owner decomposing without flipping (#11632); (b) assignee residue from the 2026-08-24 identity incident and from filer self-assign, with the claim protocol saying "comments are the arbiter" but NOTHING instructing residue cleanup; (c) decision-shaped cards mislabeled `pm:queue` when their own bodies demand a ruling (#4795 「需裁决」, #4806 「本条不带 pm:queue 的原因」 — the card text and the label directly contradicting). Rules: assignee⊕pm:queue is a flagged pair unless a fresh claim comment exists; first-touch grading must check label-vs-body-disposition agreement.
3. **`needs:contract-review` lingering after PASS** (#11284 card-side, this seat's own miss today: verdict posted, PR cleared, card write skipped) — the dual-carrier clear is two writes with read-back required per carrier, but the checklist doesn't enumerate the carriers as a PAIRED postcondition. Rule for `references/contract-review.md`: a PASS is complete only when BOTH carriers read back clear in the same stroke; a patrol row flags a card whose latest review comment says PASS while the label survives on either carrier. Companion rule: `needs:contract-review` on a card with NO open PR carrier (#10025, standing noise for days) is premature — the gate label hangs at PR-open time, not at ruling-request time.
4. **Stale `pm:blocking` derivations** (#10032 pointing at a 404'd dependent; #9465 with all dependents closed) — H14 derives additively but never retires. Rule: the derivation is a two-way sync — recompute the dependent set each patrol and STRIP when it is empty or every named dependent is closed/404.

The original card's two H-rules plus these four make one coherent deliverable: a `scripts/pm/` patrol extension (report-only first, per the H21 precedent) + the matching one-line transition wordings in the skill text. Governed surface ⇒ draft PR, human merge; the patrol script half is ungoverned.
